features.name: Multiplier Boosts

review:
A lo-fi urban 35-liner with multiplier lights. Landing the lightning bolt switches on a multiplier row, which starts each spin at a random 2x to 10x.

Wins on an active row raise its multiplier by one for each winning symbol, a Multiplier Boost doubles a row, and the Epic Boost doubles every row. Wins across several active rows add their multipliers together. Rated 3/5, 5,000x max, top RTP 96.28%. Original idea, calmer mood than most Hacksaw.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
